title: Gandhari language
extract: Gandhārī was an Indo-Aryan Prakrit language attested mainly in texts dated between the 3rd century BCE and 4th century CE in the region of Gandhāra, in the northwestern Indian subcontinent. The language was heavily used by the former Buddhist cultures of Central Asia and its inscriptions have been found as far away as Luoyang and Anyang in eastern China.
